name: variable-pipe-robot-control
description: Control system for a wheeled robot moving inside pipelines with variable cross-section (simulation, Rust engine + React UI)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web install && cargo build -p api-server
scripts.build: cargo build --release --workspace && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.experiments: cargo run --release -p simulation-engine --bin pipesim -- presets examples/experiments
